item.title: Kubemoot
item.description: Kubemoot is an open-source Kubernetes operator that turns Architecture Definition Language rules into Custom Resources, so AI agents are deployed, governed, and reconciled the same way as any other workload.

item.title: Architecture as Code
item.description: Defining architecture in executable form, so structure, constraints and governance can be tested and verified rather than drawn.
